title: P104: independent native-map inventory, caller and funding audit of PR5551 (no kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLHyt4JgKMsPAX3AsS4XP6dx)_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Audit, no new κ.** An independent check of #5551 (coupled P104 contacts, conditional κ .00304153, package `research/p104-joint-contact` on main) along the lines of its intake note. That note asks for the producer/caller and the coupled-contact delta to be reviewed together, with the native paid-map inventory, all productive targets and complete funding, in a serial bounded replay. All four layers pass:

1. **Own exact replay** of the #5551 and #5545 words, importing no source code. It checks strict span nesting for every MOVE, a common chart for every ADD/COPY/SCALE, all 743 endpoint rows and the owned lifetimes. Delta: the scalar program is identical up to frame labels, with exactly 6 ADD + 15 SCALE chart edits and local paid delta 2H1 − 3H2 + H3 − H4 + H5. All public endpoint spans and the helper profile are unchanged.
2. **#5550 caller/target checker on #5551.** Chris R's byte-pinned checker is used with four input lines changed in a temporary copy, as in #5567. Positive control: it reproduces the complete #5550 output on #5545 byte for byte (`b51a7d19…4009`). Result on #5551: PASS. The checker recounts the invoice as 69,912 paid / 12,814 productive and runs 288 exact signed-Pauli/phase-anchor checks and 9,486 fresh-helper checks. Ordinary passes are 127,292,680 ≤ 184,647,552. All ten controls reject, and so does a changed invoice.
3. **Dense native inventory of the whole word.** This covers 2,940 distinct MOVE maps, 40 helper endpoint pairs and 208 intrinsic main adapters, 3,188 operators in all. #5548's credited exact Gaussian-dyadic interpreter compares each one on all 512 columns with absolute phase, norm and support size 2^rank. Every operator passes. Earlier dense audits covered only the maps new to each word (3 for #5545, 4 in #5551's native peer), and #5550 records `paid_native_maps_replayed: false`. Two separately written drivers produced the same 3,187 distinct digests. A phase-only fault with an unchanged signed tableau is rejected, and so is a flipped child sign.
4. **Own funding engine.** It uses 80-digit decimal ln/exp with 10⁻⁷⁰ padding and shares no code with #5551's two engines or its funding peer. Raw crossing (.00304153116714, .00304153116715), equal to the author interval. The signs at .00304117, .00304153 and .0030415305 are positive; at .00304154 the sign is negative.

Remaining obligations: the uniform compiler for all recursion levels (the finite word is checked, the uniform word is not materialized), owned erasure, precision/tape, analytic recovery, #5551's own outer conjunction and certified constant, and maintainer acceptance.

## Task and overlap

Base `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`. All inputs are canonical files on main, pinned by blob and SHA-256. Card `scalar-to-moment`, scope **refined**: this audits a changed paid itinerary that #5551 already proposed. I checked main and open PRs through #5570 and found no full-inventory check of #5551. Nearest work: #5548 (dense interpreter, 3 maps of #5545), #5550 (caller checker), #5557, #5567 (same checker patch), and #5551's own native/funding peers. #5553, #5561 and #5569 build on #5551.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-contact-native-caller-audit
```

Result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`, serial, about 5 min 7 s, standard library only. The default run checks layers 1, 2 and 4 completely. For layer 3 it checks a fixed subset (all 4 new maps, all 40 helper pairs, all 208 adapters and every 32nd MOVE map) whose digests must equal the committed `FULL-CHECK.json`. `verify.py --full --jobs 4` recomputes all 3,188 digests in about 11 min on four cores. That run was performed and its result is `FULL-CHECK.json`. It is not part of the bounded CI command.

## Credit

thu-nmrc (#5551). Chris R / Clear1nsight (#5550 checker, used unchanged except four input lines; #5548 dense interpreter, imported unchanged). Ali Romman (#5544/#5545, P104 caller). The P104 lineage and all native, Clifford, compiler and analytic contributors are credited in the cited packages. Prepared for Matarener with Claude (Anthropic), via Claude Code. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

- Bind #5550's uniform-compiler contract to the `FULL-CHECK.json` digests, so the finite native check carries to every recursion level.
- Maintainer admission of #5551, after which #5553/#5561/#5569 rest on an admitted parent.
